# Location / Time 📍

Leaving from [opposite Greenfingers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gvaAx1G4ErxGZzsRA) at 6pm.

# Pacing ⚡️

**Inbetweeners** pace 28-31km/h (17.4-19.25mph) but no drop.

We will regroup at the top of hills and ride the pace of the slowest rider. Do please make sure you're comfortable regularly riding at the bottom end of the pace.

# Après Cycle 🍻

No planned stops on this ride. There's an option to go to [Totally Tapped](https://totallybrewed.com) [[Map]](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d96iZPxoZC3HerSVA) after for people wanting a post ride social drink (alcohol free options available) and pasta ordered in from next door.

We arrive at ~7:30pm if anyone else wants to join for a social (everyone welcome: non-members, partners, dogs).

# Notes

Please take a look at the route and familiarise yourself with it just in case the group gets split for some reason.

If we go over 12 riders, we'll split into groups.

See [group riding etiquette](https://beeston.cc/groupriding/), if you're newer to the group.

See the GPX file attached for those with bike computers/Strava etc.

Join the WhatsApp community for Beeston and the "Totally Tapped Tuesdays 🤌" Group for updates and chat.
